concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create one beautifully art-directed 16:9 landscape character design concept board for the original Chinese history walking animation 一步千年. The user wants silhouette characters that evoke the dignity of ordinary working people, not a skinny generic stick figure. Main subject: one anonymous ordinary Chinese adult traveler, full body in strict side profile facing RIGHT, sturdy human proportions, broad practical hands, strong calves, modest everyday loose cloth shirt and trousers, flat cloth walking shoes. Calm, grounded, slightly weathered in bearing, neither heroic posing nor caricature. Convey a lifetime of work through physical weight and modest clothing, not through a specific occupation or identity. No actual historical or public person. No weapons, flags, slogans, uniforms, political imagery, halos, or heroic propaganda composition. No bicycle or any vehicle, wheels, riding, cart, horse or flight. No walking stick, load, tools or props that would obscure the gait. Small ochre-red cloth at waist or cuff as identity cue, not a modern branded outfit. Face must be a simple solid side-profile silhouette, readable nose and chin but NO eyes or detailed face. The character is predominantly a SOLID DARK SILHOUETTE, not an outlined drawing, no skeletal or thin line limbs.
Layout: warm ivory paper, generous negative space, ONE large full-body walking figure occupying around 60% of image height in the upper main area, feet genuinely resting on a subtle physical ground line. Very subdued Chinese earth/riverbank horizon, only enough to ground the figure; no elaborate scene stealing attention. Along bottom a clearly separated understated motion-study strip shows THREE small silhouettes of the SAME character, chronological contact -> passing -> push-off, with visibly different limb poses and natural opposing arm swing, torso weight carried over the support foot. These are sequential pose studies of the same person, not extra protagonists. Keep body proportions and costume identical across the main figure and the three thumbnails. No feet floating, no extreme high knees, no marching, no jogging, no sliding stance. Large clear graphic silhouette and realistic weight transfer matter most. Limit text to the small concept identifier specified below; no captions, no watermarks. This is an image concept for choosing visual direction, not an animation or finished film.
DIRECTION A: Chinese original woodcut print, dense near-black silhouette with a few sparing pale carved cuts indicating coarse fabric folds; expressive rugged hand-cut outer edge, powerful squared shoulders, stocky but realistic build, broad planted feet. Shirt with rolled sleeves, loose practical trousers. A small muted rusty-red tied waist cloth. Hand-printed coarse paper grain, charcoal black and earth brown, matte flat ink, no decorative red background. Ordinary working person's body language: slightly forward-weighted chest, relaxed shoulders, a long but unforced walking stride. Refined restrained printmaking, NOT a propaganda poster. Small upper-left text exactly: "A · 木刻剪影".
